body_east:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit.
Asset: one headless RimWorld pawn BODY texture, transparent PNG.
Image 1: exact current Vertin costume/identity to edit. Image 2: genuine Thorns/Texas/Silence pawn BODY textures, authoritative for bold ink weight, compact mass and restrained hand-drawn game rendering.
Keep Vertin's dark plum/violet tailored tailcoat, black standing collar and waistcoat, ivory layered cravat (only if visible in this view), blue-gray inner tailcoat lining, dark trousers, tall plum boots, small pale buckles and indigo tabs. Keep identifying ornament positions and coat-tail lengths. No arms, hands, long sleeves, backpack, weapons or extra equipment; only tiny shoulder caps. HEADLESS: no face, hair, hat or detached head.
Rendering correction in ALL views: substantially HEAVIER near-black OUTER CONTOUR than image 1, comparable to reference pawn sprites. Target 3–4 pixels at a final 256x256 canvas, roughly 4 percent of the visible torso's width. Outer silhouette must read unmistakably at native scale. Clean antialiased edge with a strong opaque dark core.
Interior contours should be subordinate to the silhouette: selective short/broken tapered strokes, simple irregular cloth overlaps, not a continuous geometrical network of equally thick polygon borders. Avoid a polished vector-icon look. Use broad flat matte colors and at most 2–3 restrained local-color shades, no realistic highlights, glossy gradients, lace microtexture or fine fabric marks. Preserve meaningful costume details as readable simplified shapes.
Boots: compact closed pawns' feet. Short round-to-tapered toe aligned with the leg axis, heel integrated into the boot mass. No long horizontal toe, projecting rear heel, high-heeled fashion foot or L-shaped ankle. Keep boot tops, buckles and small tabs.
Coat tails: preserve the long-tail identity and blue-gray lining, but merge repeated small triangular serrations into 1–2 larger overlapping cloth planes with a more continuous outer edge. Do not add limbs disguised as fabric.
Output ONE body in the specified view only, actual alpha transparency, complete neck-to-foot silhouette with padding. No colored backdrop, ground shadow, text, labels, grid, frame or comparison panel.
VIEW: exact right-facing EAST profile.
PRIORITY: REBUILD THE BODY SHAPE. Do NOT preserve the thin, pinched, bent silhouette of image 1. The user's complaint is that it looks like a > sign instead of a / slash.
Image 3 is a GEOMETRY GUIDE ONLY: a thicker continuous diagonal mass with a cyan axis. Follow its broad chest/waist/hip/leg proportions and continuous down-left centerline, but render Vertin's real outfit from image 1. Do not copy the guide's blue axis, gray palette, polygon edges or blank surface. Guide is not a new costume.
Increase actual torso depth at chest and waist by about 25–35 percent, and leg/ankle thickness by about 20–25 percent, without making the whole character taller. Fill the deep concave hollow at the lower back. Keep mild fitted tailoring instead of a wasp waist. The upper body must not lean backward and must not bulge right at the middle into a > or S. From shoulder through waist and hip down the leg, produce a coherent broad / slant. Upper section leans slightly forward, lower section a little more, joined smoothly with no sharp waist pivot or bent knee.
Keep the neck attachment near its original place and the feet near their original bottom height. The head is separate and must not be rotated. Most of the increase should be actual chest/waist/leg thickness, not a huge flared tail or bag. Make the sole a short rounded end to the same diagonal leg.

head_south:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Asset: ONE transparent RimWorld pawn HEAD-only texture of Vertin.
Image 1 is the exact existing head to EDIT. Preserve this character, identity, hairstyle, hat shape/tilt, eye size, long tapered adult face, neutral expression, all feature positions and the exact view. Do not make the face baby-chibi or enlarge eyes.
Image 2 is genuine Thorns/Texas/Silence game head artwork: use only its thick black silhouette and compact readable ink treatment. Do NOT copy reference anatomy, ears, hair colors or accessories.
Primary change: a substantially bolder near-black OUTER silhouette around hat, ribbons, hair, ears and chin, matching RimWorld pawn line weight. Target a sturdy 3 native pixel line at the final roughly 110-pixel-wide subject (about 3 percent of subject width), with opaque dark core and clean antialiasing. Not a soft drop shadow or diffuse dark halo. Major hatband and hair overlaps have firm dark strokes; eyes/nose/mouth remain smaller and restrained.
Preserve Vertin's ash-beige side-parted short hair, gray-green eyes, low dark plum top hat, blue-gray band, bow and two ribbon tails with black tips. Keep their existing visible-side placement. Keep the current broad matte color areas; no new detailed strands, fabric noise, reflective shine or photoreal lighting. A few tapered partial hair-division marks instead of a mechanical web of uniform polygon borders.
Keep head UPRIGHT, unrotated, as in image 1; it must not follow the body lean.
HEAD ONLY: no neck, shoulders, body, hands or added ornaments. Genuine transparent background, one complete isolated head with padding. No text, grid, background color, cast shadow or extra views.
VIEW: SOUTH / FRONT, with the same mature face geometry and eye size.
